seo.title: About Valencia Dentistry | Dentist in Santa Clarita
seo.description: Meet the Valencia Dentistry team in Santa Clarita: holistic, personal dentistry with 3D imaging, PRF therapy and same-day crowns.

sections.heading: Dentistry with heart, in Valencia.
sections.lead: Valencia Dentistry blends clinical precision and modern technology with a warm, personal approach. Our team, led by Dr. Nuriel Lavi, takes the time to explain every step, so you are never rushed.

image.alt: A digital scan with a hygienist at Valencia Dentistry

sections.heading: Santa Clarita's dental home
body: Valencia Dentistry serves Santa Clarita families from Tourney Road in Valencia. It is a place where advanced care and genuine kindness sit side by side: a calm office, a small team that knows your name, and a dentist who treats every patient the way he would treat his own family.
The mission is simple. High-quality dentistry should be accessible, compassionate and truly patient-centered, whether you are here for a routine cleaning or a full smile reconstruction.

image.alt: Reviewing a smile plan on screen with a patient at Valencia Dentistry

sections.heading: The values behind every appointment
sections.lead: We practice holistic, integrative dentistry: we look beyond the symptom to the cause, choose biocompatible materials, and plan for your long-term health rather than a quick fix.

items.title: Individualized attention
items.text: Every patient, every visit, gets our full focus.

items.title: Holistic approach
items.text: We consider your whole-body wellness and use biocompatible, mercury-free materials.

items.title: Long-term outlook
items.text: Prevention, education and lasting solutions over short-term patches.

items.title: Comfort and clarity
items.text: Sedation options, plain-language explanations and a friendly, unhurried atmosphere.

items.title: Excellence in care
items.text: Advanced technology and proven techniques, with no shortcuts.

items.title: Honesty and transparency
items.text: Options and costs explained up front. No surprises.

items.title: Community commitment
items.text: Serving Santa Clarita, Valencia, Stevenson Ranch, Newhall, Saugus and Canyon Country with pride.

items.title: Flexible scheduling
items.text: Convenient appointment times and same-day care when you need it.

sections.heading: Led by Dr. Nuriel Lavi, DDS
sections.lead: Dentist and practice owner, known for compassionate care, technical precision and the long-term relationships he builds with patients.

sections.heading: Technology in the office, explained
sections.lead: Our office is equipped for safe, efficient and minimally invasive care. Here is what each tool means for you.

items.title: 3D CBCT imaging
items.text: Detailed three-dimensional scans for precise diagnosis and guided implant planning.
items.forYou: Implants are planned on your own scan, so there are fewer surprises on the day.
items.label: Advanced diagnostics

image.alt: A panoramic X-ray on screen at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: iTero digital scanning
items.text: Digital impressions for Invisalign, crowns and smile previews.
items.forYou: No goopy trays, and you can preview your new smile on screen.
items.label: Digital impressions

image.alt: A digital iTero scan at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: PRF therapy
items.text: Platelet-rich fibrin from your own blood.
items.forYou: Used after surgery and grafting to support your healing.
items.label: Natural healing

image.alt: A calm treatment room with natural light at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: Guided implant surgery
items.text: Implants placed with a surgical guide planned on your CBCT scan.
items.forYou: Accurate placement that is mapped out before your procedure begins.
items.label: Precise placement

image.alt: Showing an implant on a model at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: In-house crowns
items.text: Custom crowns designed and made on site.
items.forYou: Many patients leave with the final crown the same day.
items.label: Same-day crowns

image.alt: A patient smiling during a try-in at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.text: Clear close-up images of your teeth.
items.forYou: You see what we see, so your options are easier to understand.
items.label: See what we see

image.alt: A digital scan of a patient's teeth at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: Laser dentistry
items.text: Precise, gentle treatment of soft tissue.
items.forYou: Less bleeding and a faster recovery.
items.label: Gentle treatment

image.alt: A hygienist cleaning a patient's teeth at Valencia Dentistry

items.title: Sedation options
items.text: Comfort choices for anxious patients and longer procedures.
items.forYou: We talk through what would help you relax at your consultation.
items.label: Comfort first

image.alt: A digital smile plan on screen at Valencia Dentistry

sections.heading: Everything under one roof
sections.lead: Our care spans the full spectrum of dental care, from your child's first checkup to smile restoration.

categories.title: Preventive care
categories.text: Routine cleanings, exams, oral cancer screenings and education to keep your smile healthy year round.

categories.title: Family dentistry
categories.text: Care for all ages, including infant exams, pediatric treatments and ongoing care for adults and seniors.

categories.title: Cosmetic dentistry
categories.text: Whitening, veneers, Invisalign and smile makeovers customized to your goals.

categories.title: Restorative & surgical
categories.text: Crowns, bridges, implants, bone grafting and PRF-supported surgery for advanced needs.

sections.heading: Come see the office
sections.lead: 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, in Valencia. Free parking and an elevator to the second floor.

sections.heading: Become part of the family.
sections.text: Schedule your consultation today. New patients receive a comprehensive exam and X-rays.
